title: Agentic-IC3: Enabling Semantic Proof Search in IC3 Model Checking
summary: IC3 is a state-of-the-art algorithm for hardware model checking that proves safety properties by incrementally constructing an inductive invariant consisting of a set of lemmas. Its effectiveness depends on generalization heuristics that identify useful lemmas and guide proof search. However, many leading IC3 hardware model checkers operate on lowered, bit-level representations, where high-level design relationships are difficult to exploit for generalization.
